description: Processing by a processor is not governed by a contract or legal act binding the processor to the controller as required by Article 28.3. The contract must specify subject matter, duration, nature, purpose of processing, type of personal data, categories of data subjects, and controller/processor obligations.
applicability: Applicable whenever a controller engages a processor to process personal data on its behalf. Requires written contracts or other legal acts containing mandatory clauses specified in Article 28.3.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of vendor contracts, service agreements, and processor relationships. Requires verification that contracts exist and contain all mandatory Article 28.3 clauses.
